description: Recorded July experiments, recomputed without running new battles.
quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; medians match statistics.median.

pairing.producer_review: Authored style overwrites constructor roll; deterministic stats/moves; separate seeded roster/loadout streams; seeded battle RNG.
pairing.interpretation: Recorded scenario pairing is verified; full input matching additionally relies on the archived producer. This is not a replay of the historical engine.

sampling: Uniform authored-roster draws, level30, same seeds within each format; player receives two common relics and both sides held items. No human play data.
